# Home Assistant integration for UniFi Drive / UNAS v0.6.2 - Reliability Hardening

Focused maintenance release for the tracked Bronze/Silver/Gold readiness line.

## Highlights

- Cleans config-entry runtime data and listener registrations when platform
  setup fails after coordinator creation.
- Delays duplicate-discovery cleanup scheduling until entry setup has completed
  successfully.
- Strengthens tracked-file hygiene checks to catch standalone JWT-like
  long-lived token shapes.
- Adds explicit platform parallel-update declarations, higher-tier
  quality-scale tracking, Bandit CI coverage, and README Platinum-readiness
  documentation without changing the feature surface.
- Adds a typed runtime `ConfigEntry` foundation, `py.typed`, and translated
  service action exceptions as additional Platinum-readiness groundwork.
- Completes the tracked Bronze, Silver, and Gold quality-scale statuses with
  translated entity action errors, icon translations, stale-device removal
  support, and an enforced coverage gate above 95%.
- Keeps powered-off/offline devices out of snapshot-read repairs so
  Wake-on-LAN remains the intended recovery path.
- Hardens damaged config-entry handling for missing hosts and corrupted numeric
  option defaults, including reconfigure form recovery after malformed stored
  values.
- Adds a documented live HA validation pass for UniFi OS firmware 5.1.8. The
  follow-up pass installed UniFi OS 5.1.10 through the integration update entity
  and covered the update reboot window, post-update recovery, reload behavior,
  diagnostics, repairs, and negative update-version handling.
- Extends the UniFi OS 5.1.10 live validation with firmware-dependent
  fan-control, snapshot-control, update-safety, diagnostics, repairs, and
  device-registry checks while avoiding destructive snapshot and power actions.
- Adds a strict mypy gate for runtime, the API client/mixins, config-flow
  helper, diagnostics, discovery, repairs, services, snapshot, storage and
  support modules, and fixes the first typing issues found by that gate.
- Extends the strict mypy gate to config-entry setup/unload, coordinator,
  discovery parsing, shared entity base helpers, and typed snapshot schedule
  service updates.
- Strengthens repository validation so the strict mypy gate must reference
  existing files and cover every API client module.
- Keeps Home Assistant Device Info firmware metadata in sync with coordinator
  refresh data after UniFi OS updates.
- Moves GitHub workflow actions to Node.js 24-capable releases and adds a
  repository check that rejects the deprecated Node.js 20 action versions.
- Keeps the existing architecture, HACS metadata, diagnostics schema, discovery
  behavior, and snapshot feature surface unchanged.

## Validation

- `python scripts/check_repo.py`
- `python -m ruff check custom_components tests scripts`
- `python -m mypy --config-file mypy.ini`
- `bandit -q -r custom_components scripts`
- `python -m coverage run -m pytest -q`
- `python -m coverage report`
- `python -m compileall -q custom_components/unifi_unas tests`
- `git diff --check`
